sections.heading: Why pay for batch PDF tools when your browser can do it free?
body: Competitors like Smallpdf or iLovePDF restrict multi-file batch processing to expensive monthly subscription plans.
Zcompressor leverages your computer or phone's modern multi-core CPU to compress dozens of PDF documents in parallel directly inside your browser sandbox—completely free of charge.

faq.q: How many PDFs can I batch compress at once?
faq.a: There is no artificial file count limit. You can select 5, 20, or 50 PDFs and compress them all in one operation.
